arxiv-2001-00752.title: A Solution Strategy to the Unit Commitment Problem Incorporating Manifold Uncertainties Note: This work was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China under Grant 51777103. Journal: Electric Power Systems Research
arxiv-2001-00752.creator: Fang Zhai, Libao Shi
arxiv-2001-00752.description: Abstract The widespread uncertainties have made the interaction between wind power and power grid more complicated and difficult to model and handle. This paper proposes an approach for the solution of unit commitment (UC) problem incorporating multiple uncertainties that exist in both wind power and power grid inherently, consisting of probability, possibility, and interval measures.

arxiv-2109-15144.title: A Review of Text Style Transfer using Deep Learning
arxiv-2109-15144.creator: Martina Toshevska, Sonja Gievska
arxiv-2109-15144.description: Abstract Style is an integral component of a sentence indicated by the choice of words a person makes. Different people have different ways of expressing themselves, however, they adjust their speaking and writing style to a social context, an audience, an interlocutor or the formality of an occasion.

arxiv-2206-02126.title: Learning Dynamics and Generalization in Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2206-02126.creator: Clare Lyle, Mark Rowland, Will Dabney, Marta Kwiatkowksa, Yarin Gal
arxiv-2206-02126.description: Abstract Solving a reinforcement learning (RL) problem poses two competing challenges: fitting a potentially discontinuous value function, and generalizing well to new observations. In this paper, we analyze the learning dynamics of temporal difference algorithms to gain novel insight into the tension between these two objectives.

arxiv-2206-04494.title: Multi-state quantum simulations via model-space quantum imaginary time evolution
arxiv-2206-04494.creator: Takashi Tsuchimochi, Yoohee Ryo, Siu Chung Tsang, Seiichiro L. Ten-no
arxiv-2206-04494.description: Abstract We introduce the framework of model space into quantum imaginary time evolution (QITE) to enable stable estimation of ground and excited states using a quantum computer. Model-space QITE (MSQITE) propagates a model space to the exact one by retaining its orthogonality, and hence is able to describe multiple states simultaneously.

arxiv-2405-15761.title: Multi-mode δ \delta Sct stars from the Zwicky Transient Facility Survey
arxiv-2405-15761.creator: Qi Jia, Xiaodian chen, Shu Wang, Licai Deng, Yangping Luo, Qingquan Jiang
arxiv-2405-15761.description: Abstract We obtain the largest catalog of multi-mode δ \delta Sct stars in the northern sky to date using the Zwicky Transient Facility (ZTF) Data Release 20 (DR20). The catalog includes 2254 objects, of which 2181 are new to our study.

arxiv-2408-06492.title: A Random Walk on the Category of Finite Abelian p p -groups
arxiv-2408-06492.creator: Nikita Lvov
arxiv-2408-06492.description: Abstract We study an irreducible Markov chain on the category of finite abelian p p -groups, whose stationary measure is the Cohen-Lenstra distribution. This Markov chain arises when one studies the cokernel of a random matrix M M , after conditioning on a submatrix of M M . We show two surprising facts about this Markov chain.

arxiv-2504-06527.title: TSP-OCS: A Time-Series Prediction for Optimal Camera Selection in Multi-Viewpoint Surgical Video Analysis
arxiv-2504-06527.creator: Xinyu Liu, Xiaoguang Lin, Xiang Liu, Yong Yang, Hongqian Wang, Qilong Sun
arxiv-2504-06527.description: Abstract Recording the open surgery process is essential for educational and medical evaluation purposes; however, traditional single-camera methods often face challenges such as occlusions caused by the surgeon’s head and body, as well as limitations due to fixed camera angles, which reduce comprehensibility of the video content.

arxiv-2510-14664.title: SpeechLLM-as-Judges: Towards General and Interpretable Speech Quality Evaluation
arxiv-2510-14664.creator: Hui Wang Jinghua Zhao Yifan Yang Shujie Liu Junyang Chen Yanzhe Zhang, Shiwan Zhao Jinyu Li Jiaming Zhou Haoqin Sun Yan Lu Yong Qin
arxiv-2510-14664.description: Abstract Generative speech technologies are progressing rapidly, but evaluating the perceptual quality of synthetic speech remains a core challenge. Existing methods typically rely on scalar scores or binary decisions, which lack interpretability and generalization across tasks and languages. We present SpeechLLM-as-Judges, a new paradigm for enabling large language models (LLMs) to conduct structured and explanation-based speech quality evaluation.

pmc-13077253.title: Autofluorescence and white light bronchoscopy for the detection of tumor margins of non-small cell lung cancer after neoadjuvant immunotherapy: a retrospective observational study
pmc-13077253.creator: Xiaochai Hu, Jiangying Guo, Yicong Lu, Huaqiong Huang
pmc-13077253.description: BackgroundAutofluorescence bronchoscopy (AFB) is commonly utilized for the identification of abnormal tissues for early lung cancer detection. Some studies show that AFB improves the detection of precancerous lesions and cancer. However, its value for patients after neoadjuvant immunotherapy is unknown. This study investigates AFB for assessing tumor margins in such patients.
